_comment: Status anti-drift mapping: every claim in website/index.html's Status
section maps to a verifiable repo artifact. The page stays hand-authored;
this file polices it (scripts/check-status-claims.mjs, run in CI).
Semantics: shipped: every listed path must exist / the command must exit
zero. in-progress: verified as NOT shipped: every listed path must be
absent / the command must exit non-zero. Claim text must match the page's
Status list one-to-one per column. A claim on the page with no mapping
entry, or vice versa, is drift.
Every entry names the repository its evidence lives in: repo is spec (this
repository) or platform (the platform's codebase). Evidence paths and
commands are relative to that repository's root.

claims.why: No test yet compares the field reference with the schema.
